reason: This is a cross-cutting runtime-control change, not a local fix. The PR adds TiDB-side runaway time checking and touches core query/session lifecycle paths (`pkg/session/session.go`, `pkg/executor/simple.go`, `pkg/server/server.go`, `pkg/util/sqlkiller/sqlkiller.go`, `pkg/util/processinfo.go`, `pkg/util/expensivequery/expensivequery.go`). That creates real risk around executor/session correctness, query cancellation semantics, error surfacing, and unintended query kills or enforcement gaps. Even if scoped to runaway/resource-group users, the blast radius is high enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
